terra.problem: Samaria being a real place is a fact outside the passage and needs a reference.
The text does not say the vessels came from a shelf.
The six materials are not all things somebody made. The gods were made from those materials.
The text does not say Belshazzar was the life of the party or that the feast was over.
The text does not say Belshazzar was the loudest person at the feast or that nobody in the room laughed.
The text describes Belshazzar's hips and knees, but does not say he froze.
The text does not say whom Belshazzar had or had not thought of.
The text says the wise men could neither read nor interpret the inscription. It does not say they had nothing to interpret because they could not read it.
The passage does not say reading must come first or that this prevented the wise men from interpreting the writing.
The text does not say nobody in the hall had a good idea.
The queen says Nebuchadnezzar appointed Daniel chief, but she does not say Nebuchadnezzar trusted him.
The explanation repeats the queen's instruction without adding much personality or insight.
The text says the wise men came in, but it does not say they had gone.
Daniel says Belshazzar knew what happened, not how he learned it. Saying he heard the story adds a detail.
Daniel says the gods cannot see, hear, or understand, but the text does not say they are not sharing anything.
The text says God sent the hand, but does not say the other gods could not send it because they cannot see, hear, or understand.
The explanation largely repeats the quotation; noting that MENE is a short word adds little insight or personality.
The text does not say Daniel spoke plainly because the message was hard to hear.
Referring to the word on the card calls attention to the app rather than keeping Papa in the conversation.
The explanation repeats that Egyptians are not mentioned without adding much insight or personality.
Belshazzar was slain that night, but the passage does not state when Darius received the kingdom. It also does not say he received it right after Daniel interpreted PERES.
The passage does not say Darius received the kingdom on the night Belshazzar was slain.
